subject: Meet Fiber Uppercut
preheader: Knock out the fiber gap. One scoop a day.

data.headline: Fiber Uppercut is here: land the knockout for your gut
data.image_alt: A boxing glove next to a glass of Fiber Uppercut stirred into water

data.heading: A better round for your daily fiber
data.body:
Fiber Uppercut is a once-a-day powder that mixes into water, smoothies or coffee in seconds. Citrus-peach flavor, no grit, no gluten.

Mix one scoop with 8 oz of liquid. Stir, sip, done. Most people find it easiest as part of their morning routine.

Try it for $10.
